items.title: Ceasefire Holding in Gaza – Humanitarian Aid Flow Increases
items.description: A temporary ceasefire between Israel and Hamas has held for 72 hours, allowing aid convoys to enter Gaza. Over 200 trucks carrying food and medical supplies have crossed the border.

items.title: Sudan Famine Expands – 1.2 Million Now at Risk
items.description: Famine conditions have spread to four additional regions in Sudan, bringing the total population in IPC Phase 5 to over 1.2 million. Relief efforts are severely underfunded.

items.title: Breakthrough in Malaria Vaccine – 90% Efficacy in Trials
items.description: A new mRNA malaria vaccine has shown 90% efficacy in Phase III trials, offering hope for millions in Sub-Saharan Africa. Production is expected to scale by early 2027.
